US.summary:
* **Twist Bioscience Corporation (TWST)** - Principal Financial Group acquired shares on July 29 alongside the rollout of a new "Complex Genes" product.
* **uniQure N.V. (QURE)** - Reported a Q2 revenue beat and announced a Q3 AMT-130 BLA submission, driving a 6.3% pre-market stock surge.
* **RKLB** - Secured a record $266 million U.S. Space Force contract for 12 suborbital launches.
* **META** - Reported Q2 revenue of $60.8 billion but missed EPS consensus, sending shares down 9.6% after-hours.
* **HIMS** - Vowed a vigorous defense against an FTC deceptive practices lawsuit, triggering a 12%–15% stock decline.
* **ZS** - Partnered with Schwarz Digits for a sovereign SASE platform in Germany and gained 3.3% amid heavy institutional buying.
* **BioNTech SE (BNTX)** - Received European Commission marketing authorization for the 2026–2027 XFG-targeted COVID-19 vaccine formula.
* **Johnson & Johnson (JNJ)** - Completed the $1 billion acquisition of Firefly Bio and progressed its Sail Biomedicines collaboration.
* **Oracle Corporation (ORCL)** - Downgraded to the lowest investment grade tier by S&P Global Ratings due to high AI debt and capex.
* **ASX** - Dropped 8.3% ahead of its Q2 earnings release and conference call.
* **Bloom Energy Corporation (BE)** - Reported record Q2 revenue of $1.065B, raised FY2026 guidance, and surged 11%–12%.
* **Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (MRAAY)** - Experienced a $2.66 stock drop alongside a substantial decrease in short interest.
* **AMKR** - Plunged ~24% after issuing weaker-than-expected Q3 revenue guidance despite beating Q2 estimates.
* **Qnity Electronics, Inc. (Q)** - Announced accelerated next-gen tech investments and a strategic imec partnership on July 29.
* **Robo Global Robotics and Automation Index ETF (ROBO)** - Affected by a newly announced FCC ban on foreign-manufactured advanced robots and power inverters.
* **Wolfspeed, Inc. (WOLF)** - Declined 8.07% following the appointment of Andy W. Mattes as Compensation Committee Chair.
* **Sandisk Corporation (SNDK)** - Fell an additional 7.3% on July 29 amid ongoing volatility ahead of its earnings report.
* **Repligen Corporation (RGEN)** - Beat Q2 estimates, raised guidance, and agreed to acquire BioLife Solutions for $1.5 billion, sparking a major stock surge.
* **Cryoport, Inc. (CYRX)** - Filed an amended passive investment disclosure (Schedule 13G/A) with the SEC on July 29.

INDIA.summary:
* **MTARTECH** - Reported record Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹360.7 crore (+130.4% YoY) and consolidated PAT surging 364.6% YoY to ₹50.2 crore.
* **GRAVITA** - Posted Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹1,475 crore (+42% YoY) and PAT of ₹106 crore (+14% YoY), alongside an 8% stock pullback on subsidiary closure news.
* **RateGain Travel Technologies Limited (RATEGAIN)** - Released a new White Label Hotel Booking Engine and Hotel Channel Manager API integration guide.
* **QUALITY POWER ELEC EQUP L (QPOWER)** - Rating downgraded from Buy to Hold due to technical weakness and valuation concerns.
* **TANFACIND** - Received a "Buy" initiation from Choice Institutional Equities with a target price of ₹3,750, driving an 8% stock surge.
* **ENTERO** - Published its quarterly financial results for Q4 FY25-26.
* **Lumax Industries Limited (LUMAXIND)** - Announced August 6, 2026, as the record date for a FY25-26 dividend of ₹55.00 per share.
* **Cyient DLM Limited (CYIENTDLM)** - Motilal Oswal initiated coverage with a 'Buy' rating and ₹830 target, alongside unveiling a strategic transition to a product-led model.
* **Carysil Limited (CARYSIL)** - Released quarterly results reporting revenue of ₹233.72 crore and net profit of ₹27.38 crore.
* **STEELCAS** - Reported Q1 FY27 net profit of ₹23.7 crore on revenue of ₹125 crore and approved a ₹120 crore greenfield foundry expansion project.
* **SAKAR** - Reported a 120% YoY jump in Q1 FY27 net profit to ₹10.28 crore on a 38% revenue increase to ₹72.97 crore.
* **WINDLAS** - Released Q4 FY25-26 quarterly results with revenue of ₹238.50 crore and net profit of ₹15.99 crore.
* **Dynacons Systems & Solutions Limited (DSSL)** - Secured a major ₹267.58 crore contract from NPCI for server infrastructure deployment and 7-year maintenance.
* **SHREE REFRIGERATIONS LIMITED (SHREEREF)** - Released Q4 2026 financial results alongside a 4.27% stock gain.
* **BHAGYANGR** - Reported Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit surging 167.5% YoY to ₹20.25 crore on a 45.2% revenue jump to ₹705.08 crore.
* **MAMATA** - Released quarterly results with revenue at ₹73.75 crore and net profit at ₹0.01 crore.
* **NEOGEN** - Reported Q1 FY27 PAT up 67% to ₹17 crore, approved a ₹600 crore QIP to raise capital, and recovered a ₹15 crore insurance claim tranche for its Dahej plant.
